claims: As of April 2026, Scottie Scheffler has won four major championships.
Scottie Scheffler won the Masters Tournament in 2022.
Scottie Scheffler won the Masters Tournament in 2024.
Scottie Scheffler won the PGA Championship in 2025.
Scottie Scheffler won the British Open (The Open Championship) in 2025.
Scottie Scheffler had a runner-up finish in the 2022 U.S. Open.
Scottie Scheffler had a runner-up finish in the 2023 PGA Championship.
Scottie Scheffler secured his first major title at the 2022 Masters Tournament with a three-stroke victory.
Scottie Scheffler earned his second green jacket at the 2024 Masters Tournament with a four-stroke victory.
Scottie Scheffler won his third major title at the 2025 PGA Championship.
Scottie Scheffler secured his fourth major title at the 2025 The Open Championship at Royal Portrush.
Scottie Scheffler won a 2024 Olympic gold medal
